items.text: material you themes on android 12 and newer: colors from the wallpaper palette, a picked color or a photo, with a flat chat background from the same palette and a tile in chat settings appearance that turns the theme off when you pick another; switching it off restores the previous themes, auto-night rule and wallpaper
true black for the dark material theme

folder tabs stay available when the all chats folder is hidden and only one folder is left; local folders and an open folder selection survive a sync, and saved folders load on a cold start instead of only after opening chat folders
the photo and video viewer's menu no longer shows a stray separator above save to gallery when it is the only action

customize the bottom bar: up to six tabs, the stock pages in any order with chats movable too, folders or the archive as pages, tele settings or a tele section, a universal settings section, global search, new message, round video, saved messages or any chat added as a tab with its avatar and unread count, and mini apps as pages, under a glass app bar; mini apps open from their main app, named app or menu button, and keep working after a restart

an editor for the bottom bar: drag, replace (any tab except chats swaps its purpose in place), add and remove tabs, pick from the stock animated icons, choose which tabs show labels and reset to the defaults; tabs share one width with long titles cut short, saved and profile tabs show real avatars, icons center when labels are hidden, and the selected tab can show its name instead of its icon
items.where: tele → interface → bottom bar → edit tabs

items.text: round-video zoom reuses the capture request builder instead of recreating it every frame, removing the preview lag and frame freeze some devices showed when zooming while recording

kept deleted messages no longer disappear when someone sends a new message after deleting one: a repeated delete update from the server is ignored, while deleting a kept message again yourself still forgets it

chats from an older period no longer vanish from the chat list and folders: loading more chats no longer skips over dialogs because of an old pinned message, and old chats that are already loaded are no longer hidden
typed emoticons like :-( stay literal: the composer no longer auto-closes a paren that continues an emoticon

links hidden in invisible characters — zero-width text or just spaces and tabs — lose the link when copying a message, in plain, rich, Markdown and HTML copies; their spaces and tabs stay as plain text, zero-width characters go, and links over visible text stay
bulk delete of picked gifts with a permanent-delete confirmation, and drag-select: while picking, a long press and drag selects a whole range, the first gift decides select or unselect
items.where: tele → profiles and ids → select several gifts

items.text: new toggles carry a NEW badge on their settings page after an update, until the what's new page is opened
hide stories now also removes story posting entry points, not only viewing and reposting
bot profile previews can be hidden, including the bot-preview tab and its media count
incoming on-chain gift offers and their notifications can be hidden while outgoing offers stay visible
turning off Money also hides on-chain gift-offer actions
search calendar days can lose their photo and video thumbnails
an exact leading blockquote shared by a reply and the ordinary text message it answers can appear in the reply header, with inline formatting and source highlighting
incoming Money transfers can appear in tele's notification center and add a +N badge next to Money until it is opened; seen ids are bounded and stored per account
member lists fetch the first full participants page even when cached rows fill the viewport, so custom ranks no longer go missing
a download socket that times out twice on the media route before receiving data switches to the regular DC route with its own key, salt and session, keeping the same request and offset
on-chain gift buy, sell and offer flows ask for the local password before opening their action sheets, and bulk unlisting is protected too
